name: Tempester: Play List Delete Step no longer writes into the next list
explanation: [routine] (Play List screen, Shift + soft key = Delete Step; also called by [routine]) cleared 'step 100' of the list, which is the first 12 bytes of the NEXT list's header (flag word, float, End setting: [address] sb zero,0x4dc(s0); [address] [routine](list,100,0); [address] sb zero,0x4e0(s0) x8), and its shift loop stopped at step 98 so step 99 was duplicated instead of cleared. Rewritten in place (same entry, same 0x28 frame, same tail call to [routine]): steps i+1..99 are shifted down by one inside the same list (beat, repeats via [routine], 8 reserved bytes), then step 99 is emptied (beat 0, reserved bytes 0, [routine](list,99,0) so its length follows the empty-step rule, including patch playlist_empty_step). No byte outside the list is written. Unreachable rest of the old body is cleared to nop.

edits.why: sw s1,0x14(sp) ; save s1 (s2 slot 0x18 left unused: s2 is not modified)
andi s0,a1,0xff ; s0 = i = deleted step
addu s4,t1,t2 ; s4 = base of this list
addu s1,s4,t3 ; s1 = base + i*12 (step i is at s1+0x2C)
beq t4,zero,[address] ; i >= 99: nothing to shift
lbu t5,0x38(s1) ; beat of step i+1
sb t5,0x2c(s1) ; -> beat of step i (before the length is recomputed)
lw t6,0x3c(s1) ; reserved bytes 0-3 of step i+1
lw t7,0x40(s1) ; reserved bytes 4-7 of step i+1
jal [address] ; [routine](list, i, repeats of step i+1): writes repeats, recomputes length
delay slot: a2 = repeats of step i+1
sw zero,0x4d8(s4) ; step 99 reserved bytes 4-7 = 0 (0x4D8+4 = 0x4DC: end of this list)
j [address] ; tail call [routine](list), as the original
addiu sp,sp,0x28 ; delay slot: pop frame
nop ; unreachable (old body of the original function)
